essence: The Ganga mantra is ritually framed by Veda-vyasa as sage, its meter, its composition, and Ganga as deity.
When performed as previously prescribed, this mantra yields all desired results.
The prescribed Ganga mantra is the complete salutation formula presented in this unit.
The six-limb procedure is defined by assigning the stated syllable groups to the limbs.
Reciting one hundred thousand syllables and performing the fire-offering as before makes this practice effective.
